decisions.item_text: When the certifying person certifies or confirms batches remotely, this is done in full compliance with the applicable legislation and GMP guidelines.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers remote certification by the certifying person.

decisions.item_text: In every case the certifying person performs batch certification or confirmation while located within the EU/EEA or Northern Ireland, and this location is proven by technical means.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers where certification physically takes place.

decisions.item_text: The certifying person keeps up to date their knowledge of the products, the manufacturing processes and the pharmaceutical quality system.
decisions.reason: Keeping the certifying person's knowledge current is not yet a listed point.

decisions.item_text: The certifying person has satisfied themselves that their continued reliance on the relevant pharmaceutical quality system is well founded.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the certifying person's basis for relying on the quality system.

decisions.item_text: The certifying person can demonstrate to the competent authority their knowledge of the products and manufacturing processes they are responsible for.
decisions.reason: Demonstrating product and process knowledge to the authority is a new point.

decisions.addendum: This knowledge includes time spent physically at the site, where applicable.
decisions.reason: Adds physical presence on site to the demonstrated knowledge.

decisions.item_text: Where batches are routinely certified or confirmed remotely, this practice is described and controlled within the pharmaceutical quality system.
decisions.reason: Control of routine remote certification within the quality system is not yet listed.

decisions.addendum: Detailed site procedures covering remote certification are in place.
decisions.reason: Adds detailed site procedures to the same remote certification point.

decisions.item_text: Where national rules allow a contract certifying person who is not employed by the manufacturer, the technical agreement between the authorisation holder and that person covers remote certification and states the circumstances in which the person must attend the site.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers the agreement with a contract certifying person.

decisions.item_text: The certifying person has access to all data and computer system applications needed to decide on batch certification or confirmation.
decisions.reason: Access to the information needed for the certification decision is a new point.

decisions.item_text: The manufacturing authorisation holder provides the facilities, equipment and support the certifying person needs to work remotely, including for electronic batch certification and for completing the batch certification register remotely.
decisions.reason: Provision of facilities for remote certification is not yet listed.

decisions.item_text: IT systems used for remote batch release meet the GMP requirements for computerised systems.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers validation of IT systems used for remote release.

decisions.item_text: Every electronic action the certifying person performs at a remote location is available at the same time for inspection by the competent authorities at the authorised batch release site.
decisions.reason: Contemporaneous availability of remote actions for inspection is a new point.

decisions.item_text: The manufacturing authorisation holder ensures that only the certifying person can edit entries in the batch certification function.
decisions.reason: Restricting edit access to the certification function is not yet listed.

decisions.item_text: The manufacturing authorisation holder ensures that data transferred for remote batch certification arrive complete and unaltered.
decisions.reason: Integrity of data transferred for remote certification is a new point.

decisions.item_text: The manufacturing authorisation holder ensures that remote batch certification uses an electronic signature that meets the GMP requirements for computerised systems.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers electronic signatures for remote certification.

decisions.item_text: The certifying person can demonstrate that they fulfil their wider duties under GMP, not only batch certification.
decisions.reason: Demonstrating fulfilment of the certifying person's wider duties is a new point.

decisions.item_text: Compliance with the conditions for remote batch certification is verified, for example through the self-inspection programme at the authorised batch release site.
decisions.reason: Verifying compliance with remote certification conditions is not yet listed.

decisions.addendum: Self-inspections review ongoing compliance with the data governance policy and procedures to confirm they remain effective.
decisions.reason: States the periodic data integrity review but requires it to happen in self-inspection.
Only an optional extension of the data integrity review to data lifecycle elements.

decisions.item_text: The site has a means, such as a quality manual, documentation, flowcharts or procedures, that shows management, staff and inspectors in an easily understood way how the pharmaceutical quality system operates across the product lifecycle.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers a document showing how the quality system works.
Internal audit of the quality system is only offered as an option here.

decisions.addendum: Compliance with the national GMP rules is a condition of the manufacturing licence.
decisions.reason: Requires compliance with national GMP rules as a licence condition, beyond taking guidelines into account.
